messages:
sara_sales: Heads-up — AcmeCorp POC just blew up during the last load run. Demo clients saw lots of 503s. They want answers on SLA and pricing if we can’t stabilize. Can ops triage? Call in 15?

mike_engineer: On it. Can you paste request IDs / sample logs and which model/route was used?

sara_sales: Route `acme-poc` against `redwood-xl-1`, ~100 RPS sustained for ~2m. Request IDs: r-9f3a, r-9f3b. Demo team saw timeouts ~15–30s then 503s.

eva_support: Log snippets from frontdoor: 
```
[2026-03-14T14:22:11Z] request_id=r-9f3a upstream_error: 504 upstream timeout
[2026-03-14T14:22:12Z] request_id=r-9f3a response=503 reason="burstpool_exhausted"
[2026-03-14T14:22:35Z] request_id=r-9f3b upstream_error: autoscaler_attach_failed: region_capacity
```

kevin_oncall: Checked autoscaler: scale-up triggered at 14:21:59 but instance attach failed repeatedly due to cloud capacity constraints. Fall-through to burstpool happened, burstpool hit max_conn and started returning 503.

mike_engineer: Two quick mitigations: lower client RPS to ~40 and enable model fallback to `redwood-xl-1-small` (less GPU mem) + reduce concurrency. Also toggle `elastic-burst=true` for short term. Will that affect demo quality? sara_sales: need to confirm with Acme.

sara_sales: They'll accept reduced perf for now if demo remains responsive. Also they pressed on pricing: what uplift to dedicated reserved capacity so we avoid this next week? And security question: do we need Private deployment to avoid shared burstpool?

eva_support: Immediate actions I can run: 1) patch route config (max_rps=40, model_fallback=redwood-xl-1-small, per_conn_concurrency=1), 2) collect full log bundle and forward to Acme, 3) open infra capacity request.

infra-bot: Applying patch: set `max_rps=40`, `model_fallback=redwood-xl-1-small`, `elastic_burst=true` on route `acme-poc` (patch id: patch-5632).

infra-bot: Patch applied. Observed 503 -> 200 ratio improvement: error_rate 18% -> 2% within ~30s.

kevin_oncall: We'll open a cloud quota request (ticket CH-9876) to add GPUs in their region — ETA 48h if approved. Owner: @mike_engineer. Also pulling SOC2 docs for the security thread.

mike_engineer: Confirming I'll own CH-9876 and coordinate capacity. For demo tomorrow we recommend short-term move to one dedicated instance (dedicated-1) — pricing uplift ~30% + 1 month min commitment. Sara, relay to sales.

sara_sales: Got it. I'll propose: (a) temp mitigation + one-time credit while infra ramps, (b) upgrade path to dedicated-1 with SLA. Also will ask if they need Private (VPC/on-prem) for compliance; pinging @kevin_oncall for audit logs & KMS info.

kevin_oncall: I can provide SOC2 + KMS options and example audit log export. Reference: https://redwood.example.com/compliance/soc2 (doc bundle will be attached in PRD).

sara_sales: Quick pricing Q from Acme: can we discount token overage during POC window?

mike_engineer: Engineering-approved one-time credit for demonstrative purposes — ops to confirm and record in CRM.

eva_support: Credit logged and approved for this POC. I'll add note to Deal and post follow-up with logs + mitigation steps.

sara_sales: Recap and owners: 1) mitigation applied (eva_support), 2) infra capacity ticket CH-9876 (mike_engineer), 3) SOC2 + audit docs (kevin_oncall), 4) sales credit + dedicated proposal (sara_sales). Meeting in 30 to walk Acme through status.

mike_engineer: I'll join the call. If we see fresh 5xxs after the patch, call me immediately and paste request IDs.

sara_sales: Thanks all — will update thread after the call. Closing after demo passes. :thumbsup:
